title: Entry
description: One movement of one asset for one identity, as it crosses a wire (JSON). Mirrors `Entry` in src/domain/entry.ts. Append-only: an entry is never updated and never deleted; a mistake is corrected by posting an offsetting entry. A ProposedEntry (src/domain/post.ts) is this shape without `id`, which storage assigns. Every amount is a Minor: a whole number of the asset's smallest unit, never a float, never a string. `occurredAt` is a Date in the TypeScript type and an RFC 3339 date-time string on the wire. Unknown keys are refused unless prefixed `x-`.

id.description: Assigned by the store on append. Opaque.

tenantId.description: Whose books. Every read and every uniqueness constraint is scoped to one tenant.

identityId.description: An opaque, tenant-scoped token. Never a natural key — no email, phone, wallet address or public key. post() refuses these before anything is hashed.

assetId.description: The `id` of an Asset (schema/asset.json). Entries are keyed on it; a slug in this field is the bug that once made four payouts fail silently.

amount.description: Signed. Positive credits, negative debits. One convention, always. Zero is refused by post().

balanceBefore.description: The identity's balance of this asset before this entry.

balanceAfter.description: balanceBefore + amount. verifyChain() refuses an entry where it is not.

kind.description: Mirrors `EntryKind` in src/domain/entry.ts; tests/schema.test.mjs fails if the two lists drift. MIGRATION is a one-time backfill from a pre-ledger balance; DECAY is principled, explicit loss with a negative amount.

idempotencyKey.description: Derived from the source event (`quest:q_9:identity_1`), never a timestamp. Unique per tenant. A replay returns the original entry rather than posting a second.

occurredAt.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601. Supplied by the caller — the domain calls no clock. Hashed via toISOString(), so a consumer re-hashing an entry must render it the same way.

previousHash.description: Hash of the preceding entry for this identity; null for the first.

hash.description: sha256 over the hashed fields in the fixed order hashEntry() defines, chained onto previousHash. Changing the field set or order invalidates every existing chain.

metadata.description: Free-form and NOT part of the hash. Anything a caller needs to carry that the rules do not read.

minor.description: A whole number of the asset's smallest unit (src/domain/money.ts, the branded `Minor`). Gold at 2 decimals carries 12.34 as 1234. Bounded to JavaScript's exact integer range: minor() refuses anything Number.isSafeInteger does.

source.description: What produced the movement. `type` and `id` are hashed; `description` is not.
